title: GliderGear
specs: Must have received or arranged training with a recognized instructor to buy essential flight equipment
Verification by valid USHGA or USPPA rating card or personal reference from instructor required
blurb: GliderGear supports the paragliding and paramotoring community in Alabama, Mississippi, and Western Tennessee by providing quality equipment and support. They verify training before selling essential flight equipment. They offer training with certified paragliders under supervision.
extraNote: Will not sell uncertified gliders to beginner pilots · Will not train beginner students on uncertified gliders
